title: Coordinated create/edit/delete plus audit-log clause
whyThisCase: Same compound-split family as lock+notify. 'Create, edit, and delete …, with each action recorded' should not lose the audit-log obligation. After the context-copy fix, create/edit/delete keep Managers as actor; the audit-log unit is allowed to be written as the system. Needles only require the four ideas to survive extraction — they may be one unit or several.

mustExtract.note: Create obligation. Short needle; this document is small enough that it is unique.
The coordinated 'with each action recorded' clause. This is the content that must not be dropped.
